visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a light grey button-down shirt and khaki pants stands in a brightly lit room against a white door. He gestures actively with his hands while looking toward a cartoon character overlay of a woman's head in the bottom left corner. (2) The scene cuts to a cinematic sequence with a warm, hazy atmosphere where a man in a vintage suit sings into a classic silver microphone. A circular black-and-white portrait of an older man appears as an overlay. (3) Transition back to the host in the grey shirt who is now crossing his arms and nodding thoughtfully before uncrossing them to emphasize his points with hand movements. (4) The video displays grainy, retro footage of a large group of people singing together in what looks like a recording studio or public event from the 1980s. (5) Another archival clip shows a massive group of singers on a brightly lit concert stage, holding hands and singing emotionally. (6) Footage of a night-time protest or gathering shows hundreds of people in a large indoor hall holding up glowing mobile phone screens, creating a sea of lights. (7) The host returns to the screen in the same setting as Phase (1), now pointing directly at the camera and displaying a graphic for a new music single featuring green mountain-like layers and the names of musical collaborators.
